body:
The dashboard components were committed without formatting.

## Context

- `frontend/src/dashboard/` holds the components.

## Requirements

1. The components are formatted with the repository's Prettier settings.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `frontend/src/dashboard/types.ts` declares no `any` type.

## Non-goals

- Any behaviour change.

## Test expectations

- None beyond the existing suite.

evidence.says: runs npm run lint in frontend
